title: Rates of geodetic quantities

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: As test 1/2, for the time derivatives of U, V and N.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.BL: No file in the archive is attributable to BL for this test: the published script draws GS's TABOO files and VK's VILMA files only (correction spada-t02-01-contributors-without-data). Figure 12b of the paper draws BL's rate of U for the cap from 0 to 15 degrees; no file holds it.
not_converted.PG: No file in the archive is attributable to PG for this test: the published script draws GS's TABOO files and VK's VILMA files only (correction spada-t02-01-contributors-without-data). Figure 12b of the paper draws PG's rate of U for the cap from 0 to 15 degrees; no file holds it.

reference_data.reference_status: closed on 2026-09-15 by Sia Ghelichkhani: the archive spada2011-cost-es0701 is the reference data for this test, and what it lacks is recorded in not_converted and status. New data for a gap is added as a new original, with its own provenance and corrections.

status: converted: GS (cap, disc and point load) and VK (cap and disc) in data/converted/spada2011/spada2011-t02-02.nc. BL and PG supplied no data in the archive.
